lines.text: At a busy street market, @sai_front holds up a ripe mango, sniffs it, and hands coins to the stallholder.

new_beats.text: A warm smile spreads across @sai_front's face as the mango's scent hits.

writes.note: I added a beat at 2.5 s where @sai_front smiles at the mango's scent.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a reaction moment, so I added one timed beat after the sniff and kept the existing words unchanged.
